content: Amɔsu u sɑ̃ɑwɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro Tekoɑɔ. Wiyɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ ɡɑri kuɑ Isirelibɑn sɔ̃, n kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ yiru tem mu sere yĩirɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Osiɑsiwɑ u bɑndu dii Yudɑɔ, mɑ Yeroboɑmu, Yoɑsin bii u mɑɑ bɑndu dii Isireliɔ.

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔn nɔɔ ɡɑ nɔɔrɑmɔ Siɔnin ɡuurɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Yɑkɑsu mɑɑ sɑri kpɑrɑ yenɔ,
mɑ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Kɑɑmɛli, ten wii kpiirɑ ɡberɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ,
Dɑmɑsiɡibun torɑnu nu kpɛ̃ɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ ǹ nɛn himbɑ ɡɔsiɑmɔ.
Domi bɑ Gɑlɑdiɡibu tɑɑkɑ bɑ munkɑ.
Tɛ̃, kon de dɔ̃ɔ u nɑ u sinɑ boko Hɑsɑɛlin yɛnu wɔri,
kpɑ u Bɛni Hɑdɑdin sinɑ kpɑɑru di mɑm mɑm.
Kon ben wuu Dɑmɑsin ɡbɑ̃rɑrun ɡɑmbobɑ kɔsuku,
kpɑ n Bikɑti Afɛnin tɔmbu kpeerɑsiɑ.
Kpɑ n Bɛti Edɛnin sunɔ ɡo.
Kpɑ n de bu Siriɡibu yoru mwɛɛri bu kɑ dɑ Kiriɔ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ,
Filisitibɑn torɑnu nu kpɛ̃ɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ ǹ nɛn himbɑ ɡɔsiɑmɔ.
Domi bɑ Isireli dɑbi dɑbinu yoru mwɛɛrɑ
bɑ Edɔmubɑ nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Mɛyɑ kon de bu ben wuu Gɑsɑ dɔ̃ɔ sɔku,
kpɑ u yen dii ɡeenu di.
Kon Asidɔdun tɔmbu kɑ Asikɑlonin sunɔ kpeerɑsiɑ.
Kon Ekoroniɡibu wɔri.
Kpɑ Filisiti be bɑ tie mi kpuro bu kɑm ko.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ,
Fenisibɑn torɑnu nu kpɛ̃ɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ ǹ nɛn himbɑ ɡɔsiɑmɔ.
Domi bɑ Isireli dɑbi dɑbinu yoru mwɛɛrɑ
bɑ Edɔmubɑ nɔmu bɛriɑ.
Bɑ ǹ ben ɑrukɑwɑni yibie ye bɑ rɑɑ kɑ bu bɔkuɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, kon de bu ben wuu Tiri dɔ̃ɔ sɔku,
kpɑ u yen dii ɡeenu di.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ,
Edɔmubɑn torɑnu nu kpɛ̃ɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ ǹ nɛn himbɑ ɡɔsiɑmɔ.
Domi bɑ ben mɛro bisibu Isirelibɑ nɑɑ swĩi kɑ tɑkobi.
Bɑ ǹ bu wɔnwɔndu kue.
Ben mɔru kun mɑɑ sure.
Mɑ bɑ kɑ bu wɛrɛru sɑ̃ɑ dim dim sɑɑ kpuro.
Yen sɔ̃, kon de bu ben wuu Temɑ dɔ̃ɔ sɔku
kpɑ u Botisirɑn dii ɡeenu di.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ,
Amɔnibɑn torɑnu nu kpɛ̃ɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ ǹ nɛn himbɑ ɡɔsiɑmɔ.
Domi bɑ ɡuriɡibun nukunu bɛsukɑ Gɑlɑdiɔ,
sɑɑ ye bɑ Gɑlɑdiɡii ben tem mwɑɑmɔ
beɡim mu kɑ yɑsiɑn sɔ̃.
Yen sɔ̃, kon de bu ben wuu Rɑbɑ tɑbu wɔri bu ye dɔ̃ɔ sɔku,
kpɑ u yen dii ɡeenu di mɑm mɑm.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, tɑbun wurenu koo nɔɔrɑ nɡe woo bɔkɔ.
Kpɑ bu ben sinɑ boko kɑ win tɑbu sinɑmbu yoru mwɛɛri.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
